title: Changelog - June 2025
text:
## Changelog - June 2025
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105231
New Features:
Added Default Schema Markup to the Post Details pages of Job, Event, and Video Post Types.
Created the "Manage Offers" page in the Admin. This feature allows site owners to promote popular tools to their members and optionally use affiliate links. Click here for more information.
Added Bulgarian, Chinese (Hong Kong), Danish, Czech, English (GB), English (AU), Greek, Hungarian, Norwegian, and Serbian to the Default Website Languages, along with Text Label and Email Template support for those languages.
Added a version history system to the Web Page Builder page in the Admin, allowing Admins to roll back changes to the 10 previous saves.
Updated the "Header Search" Design Setting in the "Header Mobile-View Settings" section to include a new option called "Compact on Mobile" . This option displays a search icon next to the menu icon on mobile; when clicked, it toggles the search header open.
Added new Website & Organization schema that now loads on all frontend pages to improve SEO and enhance structured data for better visibility in search engine results.
Enhancements / Fixes:
Implemented a set of quality improvements to the API Documenation page in the Admin.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Post Type Search Results from returning accurate results when using the post category dropdown filter in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the homepage's sub-sub category dropdowns from respecting the "Content Boxes & Background Corner Styles" Design Detting.
Added support for Sub and Sub-Sub Categories as variables in SEO Templates. New SEO variables: sub_category_name and sub_sub_category_name.
The Recent Reviews sidebar widget is now compatible with the "URL Permalink" Post Type Setting.
Updated the message that displays for the "Origin Page" field on the Lead Details page when a lead is created via the API.
Fixed an issue that prevented Google Maps suggestion options from working properly when the "Location Search Suggestions" setting was set to "Only Search Within Primary Country" and the New Google Maps Places API was enabled.
Added the ability to import image titles and image descriptions when importing Multi-Photo Posts via CSV File and the API.
Added a "Year to Date" (January 1st to current date) option to select when using "Date Picker" search fields in the Admin.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Easy-Coupon Codes Add-On from working properly on checkout pages in some cases.
F ixed an issue that prevented list bullets in Froala fields (EG the "About Me" field) from displaying on member profile pages when viewed on mobile devices in some cases.
Updated the Web Page Builder in the Admin to add a Search Snippet Preview when creating or updating web pages. To use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Create/Edit Web Page >> SEO Settings Tab.
Updated the layout of the Login page for the Admin.
Added the ability to import Business Data members into different categories than they were originally when reimporting previous imports from the Business Data page in the Admin.
Improved the member import validation logic to better handle URL formats when importing members with website links via CSV file and API.
Added a help note to the Membership Plan field in the Member Quick Edit modal to clarify that changing membership plans does not modify or cancel subscriptions.
Fixed an issue that affected the ability to send the "Refund" Email Template after successfully processing refunds from the Admin.
Fixed an issue that prevented exporting Newsletter Smart Lists in some cases.
Fixed an issue with the Import Business Data tool that caused the system to import business data records with inaccurate state / province information in some cases.
Updated the Contact Details form to prevent saving "lat" and "lon" geocode information for members when the form is saved from the Member Dashboard without a location selected.
Fixed an issue that prevented the " User Subscription Name " from returning accurate information through the "Members Imported / Added / Updated / Deleted Via Admin" Webhook.
Fixed an issue that was preventing Admins from saving changing on the Post Settings and Web Page Builder pages in the Admin in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from adding cities as service areas in the Member Dashboard in some cases.
Added a "Scroll to Bottom" button for Multi-Photo Post Types to make it easier to jump to the bottom when editing long posts.
Added the ability to display the "Status" of Admin Invites on the Admin Accounts and Account Dashboard pages in the Admin.
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from sending the "New Payment Received" email notification after a "One-Time" purchase (EG a lead, digital product, etc).
Fixed an issue that prevented members from using the "Bookmark My Favorites" Add-On after logging into a website via a verification link.
Implemented performance optimizations and bug fixes for the Import Business Data tool in Admin.
Fixed an issue that prevented Digital Products set to "Custom Donation Amount" from accepting credits as payment, even when the "Allow Use of Existing Credits for Purchase" setting was enabled.
Fixed an issue that was preventing members from saving data when the Member Dashboard URLs were customized in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Bookmark Favorites Add-On from working properly when the "Enable Search Results Cache" Post Type Setting was enabled in some cases.
Updated the 'Required Label' to no longer display in the Category dropdown fields in the Get Matched Form when the label is empty.
Fixed an issue with uploading member profile images smaller than 200 by 200 pixels when the "Skip Image Size Warning for Profile Photos and Logos" Advanced Setting was enabled.
Trimmed any trailing whitespaces from data entered into the Post Categories field when editing Post Types in the Admin.
Implemented a security update to the Newsletter Signup module on the frontend.
Fixed an issue with the search results of Post keyword searches .
Fixed an issue with the search results of Post keyword searches .
Fixed an issue where the 'Member Profile Analytics' Add-On was counting post views when the post's author visited their own post's details page on the frontend.
Fixed an issue where the 'Member Profile Analytics' Add-On was counting post views when the post's author visited their own post's details page on the frontend.
Fixed an issue that prevented custom dropdown, radio button, and checkbox form field values from displaying correctly in email templates in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented custom dropdown, radio button, and checkbox form field values from displaying correctly in email templates in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the "Member Credits: Select Transaction Types Credits Can Be Applied To" setting from working properly when attempting to pay subscription invoices from the Member Dashboard when the "Recurring Membership Plan Payments" option was unchecked.
The Business Toolkit page is now compatible with Text Labels.
In all, over 70 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
